label: 🗺 Export to map
description: Render geographic data on an interactive world map. Four modes: points (markers), choropleth (color-coded polygons), heat (kernel-density overlay), arc (origin → destination lines). Optional polygon overlay layer combines any base mode with district / zone outlines. Output is interactive Leaflet HTML or static matplotlib PNG.

mode.label: Map mode
enumLabels: color polygons by value (needs WKB/WKT polygon column + value)
mode.help: points: one marker per row at lat/lon (default). choropleth: color polygon regions by a numeric value (needs a parsed geometry column + value column). heat: kernel-density heat overlay from lat/lon. arc: origin → destination lines (needs origin lat/lon + destination lat/lon).

format.label: Location format
format.help: How the location column encodes coordinates. 'lat_lon' = '37.77,-122.42' (Google / Apple style), 'lon_lat' = '-122.42,37.77' (GeoJSON / WKT axis order), 'wkt_point' = 'POINT(-122.42 37.77)', 'separate_columns' = pick a lat column and a lon column separately.

location.label: Location column
location.help: The column with the geographical coordinates. Required unless format = 'separate_columns' (then leave blank and pick lat_col + lon_col instead).

name_col.label: Name column (optional)
name_col.help: Column used as the bold tooltip headline. If blank, the row index is used.

comment_col.label: Comment column (optional)
comment_col.help: Column rendered underneath the headline. Free-form text.

geometry_col.label: Polygon geometry column
geometry_col.help: WKB-bytes column from parse_geometry. Required for choropleth mode and for the polygon-overlay layer.

value_col.label: Value column (choropleth / heat)
value_col.help: Numeric column. Choropleth: colors each polygon. Heat: weights the kernel density.

color_scale.label: Color scale (choropleth / heat)
color_scale.help: Sequential color ramp used to map the value column to polygon fills (choropleth) or heat intensity (heat).

graduate_below_px.label: Graduated symbol size (px)
graduate_below_px.help: When a polygon's bbox would render below this many pixels on screen, draw a same-colored dot at its centroid instead. Standard cartographic technique for sub-pixel features (microstates, tiny ZCTAs). Set to 0 to disable. HTML output re-evaluates on zoom — dots swap back to polygons when you zoom in enough.

overlay_polygon_col.label: Overlay polygons (multi-layer)
overlay_polygon_col.help: Optional WKB-bytes geometry column drawn as outlined polygons on top of the base mode. Use to place markers / heat / arcs over named zones.

marker_color.label: Marker color
marker_color.help: Any valid CSS color — hex, rgb(), or named. Default emerald (#10b981) matches the DIG palette.

tile_provider.label: Map tiles
tile_provider.help: Tile basemap. Carto Light is the cleanest for data overlays; OSM has the most labels; Esri NatGeo is the prettiest but heaviest.

max_points.label: Max points to plot
max_points.help: If the input has more rows than this, the step samples down. Browsers struggle past ~50K markers.

format_out.label: Output format
format_out.help: 'html' produces an interactive Leaflet map (hover tooltips, zoom, pan). 'png' produces a static rasterised view — useful for headless CI.
